Q01_data_provenance.question: Can every record be traced back to an authentic regulatory or industry source?
Q01_data_provenance.assessment: YES. All 3,019 records contain explicit source organizations, document IDs, URLs, and SHA-256 hashes.

Q02_synthetic_data_absence.question: Is the dataset free of ungrounded synthetic or hallucinated events?
Q02_synthetic_data_absence.assessment: YES. Strict zero-synthetic policy enforced. 100% of records originate from official regulatory releases.

Q03_quarantine_segregation.question: Are incomplete or uninformative reports separated from model training sets?
Q03_quarantine_segregation.assessment: YES. 474 sparse records are segregated into quarantine.jsonl and excluded from train/val/test.

Q04_schema_strictness.question: Does every event conform to the formal JSON schema definition?
Q04_schema_strictness.assessment: YES. Validated against safety_event.schema.json with 100.0% pass rate.

Q05_life_saving_rules_taxonomy.question: Does the dataset cover all 9 IOGP Life-Saving Rules?
Q05_life_saving_rules_taxonomy.assessment: YES. All 9 IOGP rules are represented with between 67 and 614 supported events each.

Q06_csra_energy_wheel.question: Are hazardous energy sources categorized using the CSRA Energy Wheel?
Q06_csra_energy_wheel.assessment: YES. Kinetic, Gravitational, Pressure, Electrical, Thermal, Chemical, Hydraulic, and Mechanical energy types mapped.

Q07_barrier_failure_attribution.question: Are physical, engineered, and procedural barrier degradation states documented?
Q07_barrier_failure_attribution.assessment: YES. Every candidate record documents barrier types, expected states, and observed states.

Q08_sif_precursor_definition.question: Is SIF potential defined via the Campbell Institute / CSRA high-energy triad?
Q08_sif_precursor_definition.assessment: YES. Precursor status is determined by high energy, human exposure path, and compromised barrier.

Q09_evidence_grounding.question: Are model labels grounded in explicit narrative spans?
Q09_evidence_grounding.assessment: YES. Every supported mapping contains text excerpts and character offset locations.

Q10_multilevel_deduplication.question: Is deduplication enforced across raw documents and normalized text?
Q10_multilevel_deduplication.assessment: YES. Multi-tier hashing identified 2,917 unique incident groups across 3,019 reports.

Q11_group_stratified_splits.question: Do dataset splits prevent near-duplicate leakage?
Q11_group_stratified_splits.assessment: YES. All members of an incident group are restricted to a single split partition.

Q12_source_heldout_evaluation.question: Is there an independent evaluation set from unseen sources?
Q12_source_heldout_evaluation.assessment: YES. Dedicated 56-record source-heldout split containing CSB and HSE investigations.

Q13_hard_negatives_benchmark.question: Are adversarial hard negatives provided to challenge over-triggering?
Q13_hard_negatives_benchmark.assessment: YES. 126 curated counterfactual hard negatives are provided in iogp_hard_negatives.jsonl.

Q14_multi_format_readiness.question: Does the ingestion pipeline support diverse report structures?
Q14_multi_format_readiness.assessment: YES. Supports safety alert narratives, investigation summaries, and behavioral observation cards.

Q15_manifest_reproducibility.question: Are split partitions documented with verifiable manifests?
Q15_manifest_reproducibility.assessment: YES. JSONL manifests for Training, Validation, and Test specify event IDs, hashes, and labels.

Q16_distribution_transparency.question: Are statistical distributions of sources, types, and labels transparently published?
Q16_distribution_transparency.assessment: YES. Published in CSV and JSON formats in dataset/v2_2/reports/.

Q17_pipeline_non_destructive.question: Were existing v2.1 baseline assets preserved without breaking changes?
Q17_pipeline_non_destructive.assessment: YES. Baseline files in dataset/final/remain intact; v2.2 operates in isolated versioned directory.

Q18_audit_summary_completeness.question: Is there a comprehensive machine-readable audit report summarizing the release?
